changelog:
Initial release: customer satisfaction and NPS survey design & analysis skillset.

- Provides interactive guidance to design professional CSAT/NPS/CES surveys and generate in-depth analysis reports (txt + Markdown) for quality managers.
- Offers clear separation from VOC (voice of customer) analysis—focusing on quantitative metrics, trends, actionable insights.
- Outputs include both questionnaire and analysis merged into a ready-to-use document (txt + md).
- Built-in standard frameworks: dimensioned question sets, NPS calculation, CES, and key quality satisfaction drivers.
- Ensures data integrity by requiring real survey responses for analysis; marks placeholders clearly if data is missing.
- Supports multiple survey scenarios: annual, post-launch, complaint closure, and quality performance tracking.
summary: 面向客户质量经理与市场质量的客户满意度/NPS调查设计与分析技能；产出专业问卷与深度分析报告文档（txt+md），区别于VOC痛点挖掘。
